summary: Security update for the sign-in page.

fixes.title: Sign-in page on Microsoft's security release
fixes.text: The sign-in page in front of the web app runs on Microsoft's newest security release of ASP.NET Core (10.0.15). Nothing else changes.

fixes.title: The previous security update installs
fixes.text: Version 2.1.28.1 could not be installed and your installation kept its version. This version installs.
